subject.title: Fix live orphan session transcript visibility

question: Should OpenClaw allow same-agent owner-scoped live transcript hits to be visible when the combined session store has no metadata entry?
rationale: This changes a transcript visibility boundary from metadata-only to path-owner-derived fallback, which is a policy/security decision even though the code keeps cross-agent and legacy basename paths fail-closed.

options.title: Accept scoped fallback
options.body: Merge this PR after maintainer sign-off because the fallback is internal, same-agent scoped, and covered by terminal proof plus regression tests.

options.title: Require gateway replay proof
options.body: Hold merge until a full Gateway/index replay proves the same live orphan path through persisted memory_search or memory-wiki behavior.

options.title: Keep metadata-only visibility
options.body: Reject or close this PR if orphan live transcript hits must remain hidden unless the session store or QMD mapping provides identity.

recommendation.title: Accept scoped fallback
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after maintainer sign-off because the fallback is internal, same-agent scoped, and covered by terminal proof plus regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work owns the localized helper surfaces and is the best available routing candidate for the visibility-boundary decision.
